Press <Action:Button_Cross@Battingcenter> at the right time to hit the balls pitched by the pitching machine. Hit the targets to earn points.
There are four targets in the Easy Game. Each target will grant the same number of points, but once a target is hit, it will not be restored until all the remaining targets are also hit.

Use <Action:Button_LS_Up@Battingcenter><Action:Button_LS_Down@Battingcenter><Action:Button_LS_Left@Battingcenter><Action:Button_LS_Right@Battingcenter> to aim your shot. If you aim well enough, you can hit multiple targets at once and earn that many times the points.
Once you hit all the targets, a bonus target will appear. However, you only get one chance to hit it. The bonus target disappears after one pitch, whether you hit it or not. Take careful aim!
(One Easy Game is 300 yen. I don't have enough money, though...)

(The Academic Course is 300 yen. Should I give it a go?)

A math question will appear on the targets. After a short amount of time, numbers will appear in its place. Press <Action:Button_Cross@Battingcenter> at  the right time to hit the ball into the correct panel.

You can also hit multiple targets at once. If one of the panels is the correct answer, you get the question right. If you're not sure of the answer, try to hit multiple targets simultaneously to increase your chances of success.
There are five questions in all. After you correctly answer three, you'll be rewarded with a special treat after each correct answer. Try to get all five questions right!
(The Academic Course is 300 yen, but I don't have that much on me...)
(The Extra Course is 300 yen. Should I give it a go?)
There are two types of plates. Green plates can be broken in one hit. Red plates turn green when hit⑬meaning they must be hit twice to break.

After every three hits on a plate, you will trigger a Bomb Chance. For one pitch,  a special, explosive ball will be thrown your way. When it hits, it will blow up and shatter any plate within their blast radius, even red plates!
Use multi-plate hits and Bomb Chance to destroy all the plates as quickly as possible!
